# lifr

Import, plot, and report Laser-Induced Fluorescence (LIF) borehole logs
from high-resolution site characterization surveys (UVOST, TarGOST, and
similar direct-push fluorescence probes).

- **Import** raw `.lif.dat.txt` logs into a tidy data frame that keeps
  every channel the instrument recorded, with boring coordinates joined
  from a locations file.
- **Edit** known-bad depth intervals with a recorded audit trail that
  travels with the data and prints in the report.
- **Summarise and plot**: depth profiles, multi-channel overviews,
  plan-view boring maps (optionally over USGS aerial imagery),
  depth-slice maps, and site summary charts.
- **Report**: a self-contained HTML site report with Summary, Data & QA,
  Processing history, and Boring logs tabs, plus Markdown and PDF.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mjorden/lifr")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(lifr)

demo <- system.file("extdata", "demo", package = "lifr")
lif <- lif_import(demo)              # logs + locations, all channels kept
lif

lif <- lif_zero_shallow(lif, depth = 1)                  # mask surface smear
lif <- lif_editor(lif, "LIF-03", top = 20, bottom = 22)  # mask an artifact
edit_history(lif)                                        # the audit trail

summarize_lif(lif)$by_boring
lif_plot_all(lif, ncol = 4)
boring_map(lif, use_instrument_color = TRUE)

site <- process_site(demo, output_dir = "out", site_name = "Demo Site")
site$reports$html
```

See
[`vignette("intro", package = "lifr")`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/articles/intro.md)
for a full walkthrough.

## Data model

Every importer returns a `lif_data` data frame with one row per depth
reading:

| Column | Meaning |
|----|----|
| `boring` | Boring name (from the log file name) |
| `depth` | Depth below ground surface, ft |
| `signal` | LIF response, %RE |
| `easting`, `northing`, `msl` | From the locations file |
| `ec`, `hp`, `color` | Optional channels: conductivity (mS/m), hydraulic push pressure (psi), emission-wavelength hex colour |
| anything else | Every other source column, under a cleaned snake_case name |

`%RE` is relative fluorescence, a screening proxy for the presence of
fluorescent product. It is not a concentration and is not comparable to
regulatory criteria; `lifr` never maps it onto such criteria.

## Synthetic data

The bundled demo site and everything in the documentation is generated
by
[`lif_simulate()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_simulate.md).
It has no relation to any real site. Use it to try the package before
you have field data.

# Package index

## Import

Read raw LIF logs and boring locations into a `lif_data` frame.

- [`lif_import()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_import.md)
  : Import a directory of LIF logs and join boring locations
- [`lif_read()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_read.md) :
  Read one raw LIF log file
- [`read_locations()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/read_locations.md)
  : Read a boring locations table
- [`new_lif_data()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_data.md)
  [`print(`*`<lif_data>`*`)`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_data.md)
  [`summary(`*`<lif_data>`*`)`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_data.md)
  : Construct a validated LIF data frame
- [`compat_rename_legacy()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/compat_rename_legacy.md)
  : Rename legacy TitleCase columns to the snake_case convention
- [`lif_simulate()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_simulate.md)
  : Simulate a synthetic LIF site

## Edit with an audit trail

- [`lif_editor()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_editor.md)
  : Zero LIF signal inside a depth window for one boring
- [`lif_editor_bulk()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_editor_bulk.md)
  : Zero LIF signal inside a depth window across all borings
- [`lif_keep()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_keep.md) :
  Keep one clean window for a boring and zero everything outside it
- [`lif_zero_shallow()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_zero_shallow.md)
  : Zero signal at or above a given depth
- [`lif_zero_below_threshold()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_zero_below_threshold.md)
  : Zero signal below a threshold value
- [`lif_apply_edits()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_apply_edits.md)
  : Apply a batch of edits from a data frame or CSV
- [`edit_history()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/edit_history.md)
  [`edit_history_save()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/edit_history.md)
  [`edit_history_clear()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/edit_history.md)
  : Inspect, save, or clear the edit history
- [`lif_get_edits()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_edits_rescue.md)
  [`lif_set_edits()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_edits_rescue.md)
  : Carry the edit history across dplyr operations
- [`new_edited_data()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/new_edited_data.md)
  [`print(`*`<edited_data>`*`)`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/new_edited_data.md)
  : Tag a data frame as carrying edit-history provenance
- [`qc_compare()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/qc_compare.md)
  : Side-by-side comparison of input and edited profiles

## Process and summarise

- [`hp_correction()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/hp_correction.md)
  : Remove the hydrostatic component from hydraulic push pressure
- [`re_feet()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/re_feet.md) :
  Integrate LIF signal over depth per boring (RE-feet)
- [`lif_downsample()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_downsample.md)
  : Thin a LIF frame to a coarser depth spacing
- [`summarize_lif()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/summarize_lif.md)
  : Summarise a LIF channel for QA reporting

## Plot

- [`lif_plot()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_plot.md) :
  Plot the LIF depth profile of one boring
- [`lif_plot_all()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_plot_all.md)
  : Plot LIF depth profiles for every boring
- [`lif_overview()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/lif_overview.md)
  : Multi-channel overview of one boring
- [`boring_map()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/boring_map.md)
  : Plan-view map of boring locations sized by peak LIF signal
- [`depth_slice_map()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/depth_slice_map.md)
  : Plan-view map of aggregated signal in a depth band
- [`fetch_basemap()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/fetch_basemap.md)
  : Fetch public-domain aerial imagery for a site
- [`theme_lifr()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/theme_lifr.md)
  : The lifr ggplot2 theme

## Site charts

- [`chart_max_response()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/chart_max_response.md)
  : Chart: maximum LIF response by boring
- [`chart_peak_by_boring()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/chart_peak_by_boring.md)
  : Chart: peak signal per boring as a lollipop
- [`chart_hp_histogram()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/chart_hp_histogram.md)
  : Chart: distribution of hydraulic push pressure
- [`chart_ec_histogram()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/chart_ec_histogram.md)
  : Chart: distribution of electrical conductivity
- [`export_site_charts()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/export_site_charts.md)
  : Write the site summary charts as PNG files

## Pipeline and report

- [`process_site()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/process_site.md)
  : Run the import -\> edit -\> correct -\> summarise -\> report
  pipeline for a site

- [`site_report()`](https://mjorden.github.io/lifr/reference/site_report.md)
  :

  Render the site report from a `lif_site` object
